edits.new: Interpret each meaning independently of its counterpart, under the same rules whether it is local or canonical, identifying each kind or activity, alternative and required identity, role, purpose, intended use, consumer and state. Local and canonical distinguish graph membership only; identical meaning text must retain the same scope in either role.
edits.old: Read meanings independently, identifying each kind or activity, alternative and required identity, role, purpose, intended use, consumer and state.
